name: Hooded Berryeater
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (espírito santo to rio grande do sul)
description: Big and chunky rainforest cotinga with a long tail. Found in the canopy of montane forests where it can be locally common, but hard to see.

name: Banded Yellow Robin
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed new guinea, including batanta (raja ampat islands, off western new guinea)
description: A medium-sized, localized bird of foothill forest. Orange legs, gray head and wings, olive back and chest band, bright yellow belly and incomplete collar from the lower throat around to the sides of the neck.

name: Guam Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Formerly guam (mariana islands); extinct in the wild; small captive population
description: Extinct in the wild, last reported in 1986.

name: Schlegel's Asity
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed dense forest of western madagascar
description: Chunky, olive-backed bird. Males have a black head, multi-colored bare facial skin, and yellow underparts.

name: Pale-bellied Mourner
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to suriname, french guiana, and amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized, dull flycatcher; resembles a Myiarchus but has smaller bill, rounder head, and little contrast between breast and belly. Locally distributed and poorly known; found in seasonally inundated and scrub woodlands on weathered white sands.

name: Brazilian Laniisoma
rangeDescription: Tropical southeastern brazil (espírito santo to eastern paraná)
description: A distinctive green-and-yellow species, slightly larger than a becard, with scaled sides and breast, a long hooked bill, and large eyes. Males have a black cap with olive-green cheeks and back and heavily scaled underparts.

name: Tanimbar Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Tanimbar islands (larat and yamdena)
description: An unmistakable, little-known, strikingly patterned small flycatcher confined to the Tanimbar Islands. Male is jet black above with a striking white eyebrow, wing patch, and sides to uppertail.

name: Racket-tailed Roller
rangeDescription: Tropical southwestern angola to northeastern tanzania and southern mozambique
description: Scarce and beautiful long-tailed roller. Varies geographically: birds in the southern part of the range have a blue breast, while those in the north have a pink breast.

name: Sulawesi White-eye
rangeDescription: Southeastern peninsula of sulawesi
description: A small songbird with a bold white eye-ring, dark eyes, a green back and forehead, a yellow throat and base to undertail, and a white belly. Groups and pairs roam woods, forest edges and patches, gardens, cultivated spaces, and scrub.

name: Planalto Slaty-Antshrike
rangeDescription: Plateau region of central and eastern brazil
description: Small antshrike found in the lower and middle levels of dry forests and at the edge of humid forests. Males are gray overall with a black crown, and white-spotted black wings and tail.

name: Tamaulipas Pygmy-Owl
rangeDescription: Northeastern mexico (southwestern tamaulipas, eastern san luis potosí, and northern hidalgo)
description: Very small owl of tropical forest in the foothills of northeast Mexico where it is endemic. Favors forest canopy and is rarely seen, but sometimes hunts low at edges; active in the daytime.

name: Olive-sided Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Breeds temperate north america; winters southward to bolivia
description: Stocky flycatcher that almost always perches conspicuously on a high bare perch with an upright posture. From the front, look for dark sides creating a vest, with a bright white stripe from throat to belly.

name: Heard Island Shag
rangeDescription: Heard island (southern indian ocean)
description: Learn about Imperial Cormorant (Heard Island): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Kai Kecil White-eye
rangeDescription: Kai kecil (kai islands)
description: A small green-and-yellow songbird, green above with a yellow rump and a uniform yellow underside. No noticeable eye-ring.

name: Sandstone Shrikethrush
rangeDescription: Northern australia (kimberley to arnhem land and northwestern queensland)
description: Large terrestrial bird with rather long bill, long tail, and strong legs. Brown above, peach-buff below, with grayish head and breast.

name: Charming Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southwestern costa rica and far western panama
description: Nearly identical to Blue-chested Hummingbird but no range overlap. Male has glittering purple-blue throat, green back and crown, paler grayish belly, and dark tail.

name: Madagascar Snipe
rangeDescription: Marshes of eastern and central massif of madagascar
description: Chunky, cryptic, short-legged, long-billed shorebird. Found in thickly vegetated wetlands, including rice fields, in eastern and central Madagascar.

name: White-winged Lark
rangeDescription: Arid steppes of central eurasia
description: Handsome lark with flashing white wing patches. Note streaky gray-brown back, white underparts, and warm rufous shoulder; male also has distinct red cap and ear coverts.

name: Kai Cicadabird
rangeDescription: Seram laut islands (gorong, manawoka, maar, and panjang), banda, watubela (tiur), tayandu (manggur), and kai islands, and eastern lesser sundas (romang, damar, and tanimbar)
description: A thrush-sized songbird. Male is entirely glossy-black, while distinctive female has a gray head, a brown back, and a buff underside with extensive barring.

name: Cape Siskin
rangeDescription: Montane scrub of south africa (southern cape province)
description: A small, flighty, brown-lemon siskin of fynbos heathland, forest edge, plantations, and gullies in the arid Karoo; partial to rocky outcrops. The lemon rump, visible in flight, and the white-tipped tail and wing feathers most easily identify it.
